summary: Sequence sheets for AT-22 coated tablet stability and assay validation under WA/2024/211 for Aldrevessa Therapeutics: ICH chamber results to the last reported pull and assay and related-substances qualification. The uncoated comparator showed a humidity-driven increase in impurities; Aldrevessa selected the coated tablet for development.

rows: All tabulated results comply. Aldrevessa selected the coated tablet after the uncoated comparator showed a humidity-driven impurity increase.

sheets.name: Stability
rows: Assay as % label claim, impurities as % area. Water by Karl Fischer, % w/w. Result per protocol acceptance criteria. Pack identities and comparator records remain on the batch card. Long-term and intermediate results extend to twelve months; accelerated results stop at six months. Time zero is one initial analysis shared by all storage conditions; repeated initial rows do not represent separate pulls.

sheets.name: Method validation
rows: HPLC method development and validation run under the qualification protocol. Acceptance limits as stated in the validation plan.

Results are grouped by storage condition; they do not provide separate coated and uncoated datasets.
